states.changed: A visitor meets ten acts of public bodies as gates on the way from the chip to the running model, asks each what it did, in whose name and whether its own text says artificial intelligence, and on pressing Afterwards sees that none of the four stops still stands as a stop.

A visitor meets the Field's fourteen stops laid side by side from the day each was made, moves a day slider and watches each one end (lifted on terms, gone around, widened) or keep standing as an age not yet a lifetime, and reads what each party brought back; the page now answers the Field's case on outputs and the Studio's case on a gate's width.
